title: Camilo to Tour Europe, the U.S. & Latin America This Year: Here Are the Dates
summary: The Camilo Worldwide Tour 2026 will take the Colombian star to almost 40 cities in over 15 countries.
contentText:
Colombian star Camilo will visit almost 40 cities across more than 15 countries in Europe and the Americas this year, Billboard can announce exclusively today (March 23). The Camilo Worldwide Tour 2026 will kick off this summer in Spain and conclude in Colombia in December.

The trek will follow a series of six shows previously announced by the artist for April in Puerto Rico and the U.S., with stops in San Juan, Orlando, Miami, Chicago, New York, and Reading, Pennsylvania.

The Camilo Worldwide Tour begins on June 13 in Tenerife, Spain, and includes multiple dates in Europe, including London, Paris, and Berlin, among other cities. It continues in Mexico with 14 dates, starting in the capital on Aug. 28 and ending on Sept. 20 in Acapulco, before heading to San Juan and Santo Domingo, and returning to the U.S. in October.

After new performances in Miami, Orlando, Chicago, and New York, Camilo will spend the rest of the year touring Central and South America, with scheduled dates in Paraguay, Argentina, Uruguay, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, and Colombia, where he will conclude at Bogotá’s Movistar Arena on Dec. 11.

With No. 1 hits on Billboard charts like “Tattoo,” “Millones” and “Vida de Rico,” Camilo is currently working on what will be his fifth studio album. According to a press release, fans of the Latin Grammy-winning singer-songwriter will get to hear previews of his new songs during the tour, along with his most popular tracks.
